page_title: NOT 0-1 FUL | Nottingham Forest v Fulham 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nottingham comes to nothing.
90+6' The linesman signals that Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90+5' Chris Wood (Nottingham) is caught offside!
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Harrison Reed (Fulham) is penalised.
90' The game is interrupted as Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) is flagged offside.
90' Chris Wood (Nottingham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
88' Here is a change. Emile Smith Rowe is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Issa Diop (Fulham).
88' Jota Silva (Nottingham) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar.
88' The ball is out of play. Nottingham will have a chance to score from a corner.
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Neco Williams (Nottingham) coming on for Alex Moreno.
84' Bernd Leno (Fulham) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
83' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Sasa Lukic will be replaced by Harrison Reed (Fulham).
83' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) replaces Raul Jimenez.
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham.
80' Jota Silva (Nottingham) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno was alert and made an astonishing save!
75' That will be all from James Ward-Prowse who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ramon Sosa (Nottingham).
74' Close! Raul Jimenez (Fulham) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
74' Kenny Tete (Fulham) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
69' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Andreas Pereira and he is replaced by Sander Berge (Fulham).
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Reiss Nelson (Fulham) comes onto the pitch for Adama Traore.
68' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
68' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) is about to take a corner kick.

64' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms over the bar.
63' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
63' Alex Moreno (Nottingham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
61' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
60' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
58' Joshua Smith shows the yellow card to Sasa Lukic (Fulham) for a heavy challenge.
57' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) replacing Nicolas Dominguez.
57' Today's match ends for Elliot Anderson who will be replaced by Jota Silva (Nottingham).
54' Kenny Tete (Fulham) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
51' 0 - 1 Goal! Raul Jimenez (Fulham) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Matz Sels.
51' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
50' Murillo (Nottingham) might have got lucky there after the VAR review resulted in the referee awarding him just a yellow card.
50' It’s a PENALTY to Fulham after the VAR review!
49' Referee Joshua Smith makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Fulham. Let’s see what happens!
48' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
48' PENALTY APPEAL after Andreas Pereira (Fulham) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
46' Nuno Espirito Santo makes a switch. Anthony Elanga is coming on in place of Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Joshua Smith blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Fulham take a short corner kick.
45+2' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
42' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nottingham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' The corner is swung in but Nottingham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

37' Alex Moreno (Nottingham) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick.

35' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the right post.
35' Adama Traore (Fulham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Joshua Smith blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) rips a first-time shot which goes well wide of the right post. Next time he should aim better. A poor effort.
31' Joshua Smith shows a yellow card to Ryan Yates (Nottingham), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
31' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
28' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Matz Sels is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
27' Celebrations are cut short for Nottingham as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
26' Attention! Referee Joshua Smith straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
25' Chris Wood (Nottingham) has a goal ruled out for offside!
25' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
23' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
22' The game is interrupted now, Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
21' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
19' Chris Wood (Nottingham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
19' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just wide of the left post.
18' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) trips an opposition player and Joshua Smith signals a foul.
14' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
14' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Nottingham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
14' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
13' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Nottingham will have an opportunity.
10' Ola Aina (Nottingham) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
9' Adama Traore (Fulham) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
8' A cross from Adama Traore (Fulham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
5' Alex Moreno (Nottingham) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
4' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
3' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
3' The ball is out of play and Fulham manage to earn a corner.
3' A cross from a corner kick by Fulham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
2' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matz Sels intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fulham.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fulham will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Joshua Smith.
